description: Turns the speech in an audio or video file at an https URL (25 MB at most; a file generate made works) into text through POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, or into English with translate. Use a transcription model id from list_models (type transcription). Billed per second of audio to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header; a request that fails is not charged.

audio_url.description: An https URL of the audio or video file: mp3, mp4, m4a, wav, webm, ogg, flac or aac, 25 MB at most. A file generate made works.

language.description: The spoken language as an ISO-639-1 code (en, es, zh...), when known.

model.description: A transcription model id from list_models (type transcription).

prompt.description: Names or words to spell right, or the text that came before.

translate.description: True: translate the speech into English instead (the models that can).

name: transcribe
title: Transcribe audio or video
